'''CT-27-3555''' was a [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadet]] and a part of [[Bravo Squad (clone cadets)/Legends|Bravo Squad]].

==Biography==
When [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] Commander [[Colt/Legends|Colt]] arrived to supervise the graduation tests of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadets]], Bravo Squad was the first team to take the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]]. During this challenge, all the cadets, including this one, worked as a team and finished the course in record time.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This clone's armor number was 5 and he only appeared in the episode [[Clone Cadets]].
